WITH RECURSIVE pack_links AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), later_versions(id) AS (SELECT v.later FROM document seed JOIN revision v ON v.earlier = seed.id WHERE seed.number = 'R5-236866' UNION SELECT v.later FROM later_versions lv JOIN revision v ON v.earlier = lv.id) SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS final_document, x.code AS disposition, p.pack_number AS cr_pack FROM document d JOIN pack_links pl ON pl.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = pl.pack_id JOIN disposition x ON x.target = d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = x.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id JOIN later_versions lv ON lv.id = d.id WHERE d.number <> 'R5-236866' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(x.evidence_status), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'sourceverified' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(x.scope), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('wholedocument', 'document', 'fulldocument', 'documentlevel', 'wholetdoc', 'tdoc') AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('ran5', 'ranwg5', 'tsgranwg5', 'tsgran5', 'r5');
